Dana (Sales): Customer in POC reports 403 when calling /v1/embeddings with a service-account key we issued. Error text: \"403 Forbidden: project not bound to key\". Demo next Tue, need quick triage.
Omar (SE): Can you share the exact curl they ran and key id (sa_ vs sk_)?
Dana (Sales): They gave this (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_trial_44'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"embed-proto","input":"test"}'
```
Lee (Infra): Likely cause: SA key lacks project/tenant binding or missing routing header. For hosted vs dedicated behavior differs. Ask them to retry adding `-H 'x-redwood-org: org_66' -H 'x-redwood-project: prj_9'` and re-run.
Omar (SE): Also check key scopes. If SA was created with only `inference.read` they can't generate embeddings. Need `embeddings.generate` or `inference.write`.
KeyBot: infra-log: req=xb8c status=403 reason=project_binding_missing key=sa_trial_44 region=eu-central
Lee (Infra): Two rapid fixes: 1) reprovision a bound SA key (scopes: embeddings.generate,inference.write) with short expiry for POC; 2) have them use a user (sk_) token which inherits org/project if they authenticate via portal. We prefer option 1 for demos since no user login needed.
Maya (Security): For the security questionnaire: explain keys can be created with expiry, we store creation/rotation/audit events and support KMS wrapping for Private deployments. Recommend issuing short-lived keys for trials. I'll draft a blurb.
Dana (Sales): If you can create a short-lived bound key and put secret in 1Password, that's ideal. Also need a quick sentence about rotation policy to pass their infosec gate.
Omar (SE): I'll create a temporary bound key (7d) and post only the key id here, secret into 1Password. Example curl to give customer after we do that:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_trial_bound'
  -H 'x-redwood-org: org_66'
  -H 'x-redwood-project: prj_9'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"embed-proto","input":"hello"}'
```
Lee (Infra): Note: if they hit 429 after fix, have them capture response headers (edge-req-id) and exact timestamps; we'll map to rate-limiter buckets.
Dana (Sales): Great - Omar please proceed and ping when done. Maya, ping me the security blurb and I'll attach it to the questionnaire.
Omar (SE): Creating now, will update ticket with key id only.
KeyBot: event: key_provisioned id=sa_trial_bound tenant=prj_9 scopes=[embeddings.generate] created_by=omar.se expiry=2026-05-01T08:00:00Z
